page.overview:
Who is Isembold Took?

Isembold Took was a Hobbit of the Shire.

Isembold was the fifth child of Gerontius Took and Adamanta Chubb. He came from a large family which included eleven other brothers and sisters: Isengrim, Hildigard, Isumbras, Hildigrim, Hildifons, Isembard, Hildibrand, Belladonna, Donnamira, Mirabella, and Isengar. The names of his wife and children are not known, though he was said to have many descendants.
